Sign in, or sign in again

Source: R/session.R
soil_login.Rd

Runs the device login of Keycloak on an existing session (see soil_connect()): prints a web address and a code, waits for the browser step, then reads /capabilities and the identity carried by the token. Use it after soil_connect(login = FALSE), or when a session has expired (soilhub_auth_error with reason = "session_expired"): the session object, and the default session, stay the same.

Usage

soil_login(soil = soil_session(), force = FALSE)

Arguments

soil

A session; the default session when omitted. Client-side: not sent to the API.

force

Open a new browser login even if the session is valid. Client-side: not sent to the API.

Value

soil, invisibly.

Details

When the session is still valid (or can be renewed) nothing is done unless force = TRUE, which always opens a new browser login (for instance to sign in as another user).

See also

soil_connect(), soil_logout()

Other session: soil_connect(), soil_logout(), soil_session(), soil_whoami()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
soil <- soil_connect(login = FALSE)
soil_login(soil)
} # }
